set.body: Owner request 2026-10-01: optimize sbt build bottleneck. Evidence: a mvpaJVM/test gate is ~45s wall vs 7s sbt task time (~85% startup/project load); one global fcntl mutex pair (/private/tmp/scalafim-execution-20260929/sbt.lock, /private/tmp/scalafim-umvpa-20260929/sbt.lock) serializes every agent (14 waiters observed) on a 14-core/36GB host; ~10 git-pinned source builds (ravel, gale, resample4s, alder, locus4s, image4s, reframe4s, graph4s, multivar, ...) compile into a shared sbt.global.base staging dir, which is why concurrent builds are unsafe. Method: hill climb in an isolated worktree with a private sbt global base; one change at a time, measured (cold gate wall, load vs task split, incremental, throughput); keep only improvements. Candidates: JVM/launcher flags, sbt build settings, warm sbt --client servers, binary-published pins (publishLocal per revision) to remove shared mutable staging, counting-semaphore replacing the global mutex. No change to other agents' workflow without Fray notice; no push.
set.title: Build throughput: hill-climb sbt gate latency and multi-agent concurrency
